finding_status.notes: document.querySelector('[data-popup-id="..."]') replaces the shared last-dialog query; each Popup instance targets its own element.
Array.from + .filter(el => el.getAttribute(...) !== 'true') replaces CSS concatenation; filter applies across all six selector rules.
Escape useEffect now returns early when !hideClose (PrimeReact closeOnEscape handles those dialogs); for hideClose dialogs a topmost-dialog data-popup-id check prevents multiple simultaneous closes.
Three new tests added: sentinel injection verifying the filter, focus-outside-dialog Tab redirect, and document.activeElement unchanged when dialog is hidden.
